levels.name: Contributor
levels.summary: Reads the memory, saves facts, proposes and runs actions. Cannot quarantine or restore, and cannot approve reviews.

levels.name: Reviewer
levels.summary: Everything a Contributor can do, plus quarantine and restore facts. Cannot approve reviews or manage people.

levels.name: Admin
levels.summary: Everything: also approves reviews and manages people, teams, links, plan and tokens.

capabilities.label: Look things up
capabilities.detail: retrieve_context, get_map, get_node, find_path, delta, blast-radius preview

capabilities.label: Stage and run actions
capabilities.detail: stage_action, execute_action (the quorum gate still decides)

capabilities.label: Claim handoffs
capabilities.note: Contributors can claim tasks only, not reviews or escalations.

capabilities.label: Manage people, teams, links, plan and tokens
